# The Clojure model contract

`(a/foreign ^:model f [x :- T …] R (fn [x …] body))` translates the function's Clojure source
into a kernel model of plain Clojure (`ansatz.clj-model`), so `f` becomes a definition rather
than an axiom. Every model operation returns `Option CljM.V`: `some v` claims that clojure.core
returns a value whose EDN is `v`; `none` claims nothing (clojure.core throws, a long overflows,
or the case is not modelled). The model is strict, so it can only miss values, never invent them.

Each row below is checked by `test/ansatz/clj_model_contract_test.clj`: the form is translated
into the model and run against clojure.core on generated EDN (edge values first: nil, booleans,
`Long/MIN_VALUE`/`MAX_VALUE`, ±0.0, NaN, a non-BMP string, keywords, `()`, `[]`, small maps,
a `hash-map`-built small map, a map over 8 entries, sets, a lazy seq). Verdicts per call:

- **agree**: the model answers and clojure.core returns the same value under a strict `=`
  (a vector is not a seq, integers and doubles differ, maps and sets are order-free);
- **throws**: the model answers none and clojure.core throws;
- **no claim**: the model answers none and clojure.core returns; the row's *max no-claim*
  bounds their fraction among returning calls;
- **model bug**: the model answers and clojure.core differs or throws. Any one fails the row.

A row checks one form; `ansatz.clj-check/check-model!` runs the same comparison for a
modelled function, and checks conformance on inputs from its declared types.

## Numbers

| Form | Inputs | Max no-claim | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `(+ a b)` | a : int, b : int | 0.0 | A long result out of range is none: Clojure throws on overflow. |
| `(+ a b)` | a : num, b : num | 0.6 | Mixed long/double is no claim in G1. |
| `(+ a b)` | a : any, b : any | 0.5 |  |
| `(+ a b c)` | a : int, b : int, c : int | 0.0 |  |
| `(+ a)` | a : any | 0.0 | (+ x) casts x to Number: (+ nil) is nil. |
| `(+)` | a : any | 0.0 |  |
| `(- a b)` | a : int, b : int | 0.05 | Boxed `-` negates its second operand first: subtracting Long/MIN_VALUE throws even when the difference fits. |
| `(- a)` | a : num | 0.0 | (- Long/MIN_VALUE) overflows. |
| `(* a b)` | a : int, b : int | 0.0 |  |
| `(* a b)` | a : num, b : num | 0.6 |  |
| `(inc a)` | a : num | 0.0 |  |
| `(dec a)` | a : num | 0.0 |  |
| `(< a b)` | a : num, b : num | 0.6 |  |
| `(<= a b)` | a : int, b : int | 0.0 |  |
| `(> a b)` | a : num, b : num | 0.6 |  |
| `(>= a b)` | a : num, b : num | 0.6 | Doubles compare by IEEE: NaN is neither >= nor <. |
| `(< a b c)` | a : int, b : int, c : any | 0.2 | Pairwise with Clojure's short circuit: (< 1 0 "x") is false. |
| `(< a)` | a : any | 0.0 | (< x) is true for any x. |
| `(zero? a)` | a : num | 0.0 |  |
| `(pos? a)` | a : num | 0.0 |  |
| `(neg? a)` | a : num | 0.0 |  |

## Equality

| Form | Inputs | Max no-claim | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `(= a b)` | a : any, b : any | 0.05 | Numeric category kept ((= 1 1.0) is false); NaN is no claim (a boxed NaN equals itself by identity). |
| `(= a b)` | a : coll, b : coll | 0.0 | Sequentials by element ((= [1 2] '(1 2)) is true), maps and sets order-free. |
| `(= a b)` | a : map, b : map | 0.0 |  |
| `(= a a)` | a : any | 0.05 |  |
| `(= a b c)` | a : key, b : key, c : key | 0.0 |  |
| `(not= a b)` | a : any, b : any | 0.05 |  |

## Truthiness and control

| Form | Inputs | Max no-claim | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `(nil? a)` | a : any | 0.0 |  |
| `(some? a)` | a : any | 0.0 |  |
| `(not a)` | a : any | 0.0 | Only nil and false are falsey: (not 0), (not "") and (not ()) are false. |
| `(identity a)` | a : any | 0.0 |  |
| `(if a b c)` | a : any, b : int, c : key | 0.0 |  |
| `(when a b)` | a : any, b : int | 0.0 |  |
| `(and a b)` | a : any, b : any | 0.0 |  |
| `(or a b)` | a : any, b : any | 0.0 |  |
| `(cond (< a b) a (> a b) b :else 0)` | a : int, b : int | 0.0 |  |
| `(let [x (+ a 1)] (* x x))` | a : int | 0.0 |  |
| `(-> m (assoc :x 1) (dissoc :a))` | m : map | 0.2 | A dissoc on a map of 9+ entries is no claim (hash-map order). |
| `(if a (throw (ex-info "no" {})) b)` | a : any, b : int | 0.0 | throw is no claim. |

|---|---|---|---|

## Collections

| Form | Inputs | Max no-claim | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `(get m k)` | m : map, k : key | 0.0 |  |
| `(get m k)` | m : any, k : key | 0.1 | get on a string is no claim in G1; on a number it is nil, as in Clojure. |
| `(get m k d)` | m : coll, k : key, d : int | 0.1 | The default only when the key is absent: (get {:a nil} :a 5) is nil. |
| `(get v i)` | v : coll, i : int | 0.1 | An index outside int range is no claim: Clojure reads it with intValue, which wraps. |
| `(:a m)` | m : any | 0.1 |  |
| `(:a m 0)` | m : map | 0.0 |  |
| `(contains? m k)` | m : coll, k : key | 0.0 |  |
| `(assoc m k v)` | m : map, k : key, v : int | 0.0 | An existing key keeps its place, a new key goes last. |
| `(assoc m 0 v)` | m : coll, v : int | 0.0 |  |
| `(assoc m :a 1 :b v)` | m : map, v : any | 0.0 |  |
| `(dissoc m k)` | m : map, k : key | 0.2 |  |
| `(count c)` | c : coll | 0.0 |  |
| `(count c)` | c : any | 0.35 | count of a string is no claim in G1 (Lean counts code points, Java UTF-16 units). |
| `[a {:k b} "s" :kw nil]` | a : any, b : int | 0.0 |  |
| `(quote (1 x [2]))` | a : any | 0.0 |  |

## Refused forms

Translation refuses what the model cannot express with `ex-info`
`{:kind :clj/refused :reason r :form f}`.

| Reason | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `:destructuring` | A destructuring binding form (G1 binds symbols only). |
| `:dispatch` | Protocols, multimethods and `case` (hash dispatch): not modelled yet. |
| `:dynamic-var` | A dynamic var or `var`: its value depends on the binding in force. |
| `:escaping-fn` | A function stored in data or returned: the model's values are data. |
| `:eval` | `eval` and reading code at runtime. |
| `:higher-order` | A higher-order function (`map`, `reduce`, …) or a call of a local (G1 has no function sort yet). |
| `:interop` | Java interop (`.method`, `Class.`, `Class/static`, `new`): no model of Java objects. |
| `:lazy-infinite` | An infinite sequence (`iterate`, `cycle`, `repeat`/`range` without a bound). |
| `:multi-arity` | A function with several arities (G1 models one). |
| `:multi-form-body` | A body with several forms: the earlier forms only run for effects. |
| `:mutable-state` | Atoms, volatiles, `deref`, `set!`: the model has no state. |
| `:recursion` | Recursion, `loop`/`recur`, `letfn` (G1 translates non-recursive functions). |
| `:regex` | Regular expressions: not modelled. |
| `:side-effect` | An effect (printing, I/O, `def`): the model is pure. |
| `:try-catch` | `try`: catching would turn a no-claim into a value. |
| `:unmodelled-fn` | A call to a function the model does not cover. |
| `:unmodelled-form` | A literal or form the model does not cover (char/BigInt/NaN literals, set or map literals with computed keys). |
| `:varargs` | A variadic parameter list `[x & more]` (G1). |
